field.name: user_id
field.label: Existing Joomla user
field.description: Select the existing Joomla user whose email address is shared

field.name: member_id
field.label: Second Member profile
field.description: Select the unlinked profile to attach to the same Joomla user
field.query: SELECT member_id, CONCAT(COALESCE(preferred_name, ''), ' (', home_group, ', profile ', member_id, ')') AS title FROM #__ra_profiles WHERE (id IS NULL OR id = 0) ORDER BY preferred_name, home_group

field.name: combined_name
field.label: Combined Joomla user name
field.description: The display name to use for the shared Joomla user
